### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, touching **32** documentable anchor(s).

**55** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `userId (5 routes)`
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (literal, 39 pages)`, `sys_user (literal, 49 pages)`
- **11** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **221** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **5** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3481db75a08438d27fa4f1c69d9fa2de5b32ca74` — the merge of head `58742b1d994edc24e006b92d8577424a20ed4c6e` into base `447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3481db75a08438d27fa4f1c69d9fa2de5b32ca74 && git checkout 3481db75a08438d27fa4f1c69d9fa2de5b32ca74
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33 58742b1d994edc24e006b92d8577424a20ed4c6e && git checkout -B drift-repro 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33 && git merge --no-ff 58742b1d994edc24e006b92d8577424a20ed4c6e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 447226b222467709ed74ca99eaf808c178656b33` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT

PR #30739 · head `58742b1d` · 2026-11-06T00:17Z · card #30324 under ruling C (6670861426, replacing ruling A) · claim 6670388278, amendment 6670440292 · os-dev report 6673033727

## 维护者速读（席位校正）

The body's lines stand as written, read against the diff. Two consequences are named in the changeset and stand: sample rows seeded before this release keep no owner (purge and reseed to have them owned), and a door with no person in hand (a heal whose recorded installer is gone, a replay handed no founder) leaves its rows unowned and logs why, rather than inventing an owner.

## 席位核对

- **Ruling fit:** every seeding door of `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` stamps `owner_id` and `created_by` with the person it names: install and reseed → the caller; boot heal → the ledger's `installedBy` when a system read still finds that `sys_user`; per-organization replay → the founder it is handed. No read rule is added; `plugin-sharing` and `plugin-security` are untouched, so the security-lane review the old ruling required does not apply (ruling C record).
- **Only rows the load created:** the selection is the loader's `insertedIds` (narrower than the claim's `landedIds`), each field written only where still empty, so a pre-existing row a seed key matched and a seed-authored owner are both left alone. `sys_*`, managed and federated objects are skipped; under a wall every predicate also carries the load's `organization_id`.
- **Write context:** `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }`, the boot claim's `CLAIM_WRITE_CTX`: no app hook, flow, approval or notification fires; code-registered hooks (audit, sharing projection) still run per row. Batches of 50 ids with a yield between, per-row retry on a refused batch, refusals counted and logged per object. The stamp never throws into the load.
- **Why not through `claimSeedOwnership`:** measured and stated in the module header (the claim keys on `app:seeded` and the seed-settlement host, which this seed does not emit, writes `owner_id` only, and targets the platform admin). Accepted.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  1. `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` +1 row, written by its own gate for the new test's engine double. Outside the named surface, gate-forced.
  2. The end-to-end pins live in `packages/cli/test/package-install-local-sample-owner.integration.test.ts` (outside the named test directory, tests only), where the real install route is booted.
- **Not covered, named for the maintainer:** `AppPlugin`'s own per-organization replayer is outside this code and was not measured; it belongs with the seat's audit finding on ownerless boot-time seeds (package install, publish seed apply, dev hot-reload), which waits on the maintainer's word to file.
- **Declarations:** `Fixes #30324`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch changeset on `@objectstack/cloud-connection`; consistent with the diff.
- **Gates (report):** 69 derived, 69 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; `pnpm lint` 0; package suite 906 passed; e2e 6/6.
- **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 30739`: NOT governed, 1195 changed lines (≤ 3000). The seat lands with `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once CI on this head is green or expected-skip.
